records.originalRussian: Отложите въ сторону эту книгу на нѣсколько минутъ и, ослабивъ мускулы вашего тѣла съ приведеніемъ въ пассивное состояніе вашего ума, спокойно и хладнокровно думайте о словахъ «я есмь», и попробуйте представить себѣ ваше истинное «я», стоящее надъ разумомъ и тѣломъ.
records.normalizedEnglish: Set the book aside for a few minutes, relax muscles and bring the mind into a passive state; calmly consider I am and imagine the true self above mind/body; continue the practice.
originalProcedureParaphrase: Set book aside for a few minutes.
Relax muscles and bring mind into the source-described passive state.
Calmly think I am and imagine the true self above mind/body.
Continue; author predicts recognition and asserts immortality/indestructibility, not an objective completion criterion.

progression.details: Continue the practice; no quantified advancement schedule.

modernChanges: Optional phrase and words instead of imagery.
Present experience/personal agency rather than required immortal higher-self belief.

records.normalizedEnglish: The source describes a higher self above mind/body and eternal/indestructible; not scientifically established by this passage.
